claim: The United Kingdom is currently a full voting member of the European Union Single Market.

annotation.adjudication_rationale: Both UK Gov (gov.uk) and European Commission confirm the UK formally departed the EU single market and customs union as of December 31, 2020.

gold_evidence.exact_quote: The transition period ended on 31 December 2020 and the UK has left the EU single market and customs union.
Since 1 January 2021, the UK is a third country and no longer participates in the EU Single Market.
